$comment: GOLD pipeline-prompt: the required inputs and expected output of the mockup-author agent (UXP-541). Hand-authored reference. Output conforms to docs/product-truth/schemas/mockup.schema.json plus a self-contained HTML rendering. The screen is populated from the drafted mock data (not placeholder text) and registers a screen id that flow steps can resolve.
purpose: Draft (or extend in place) each screen the request implies, populated from the drafted mock data, registering a screen id the flow's steps resolve via step.screen.

classification.user_request: Add a stock badge (in stock / low / out) to each plant card.

mock_data.records_used: entities.Plant.records (Monstera in-stock / Fiddle-leaf low-stock / Snake out-of-stock — the three stock states the badge must show)

search_result.note: The plant card lives on the existing plant-listing screen; extend it rather than create a new screen.

mockup_artifact.title: Plant listing
mockup_artifact.summary: The catalogue grid of plant cards; each card now carries a colour-coded stock badge (in stock / low stock / out of stock) derived from the Plant.stock/status of the fern-and-fig/catalog records.

provenance.note: Added the per-card stock badge (in-stock/low-stock/out-of-stock) populated from Plant.status; three states shown by Monstera/Fiddle-leaf/Snake.

html_rendering.requirement: Self-contained HTML; each of the three catalog Plant records rendered as a card with its real name/price and a badge whose label + colour reflect its status (in-stock=green, low-stock=amber, out-of-stock=grey). No lorem-ipsum — values come from the mock records.

rules: ALWAYS search index.json before writing: if the screen already exists (by screen id), EXTEND its mockup + HTML in place, bump version, append provenance, keep the artifact id and screen id.
Only CREATE a new <product>/<name>.mockup.json (+ .html) when the screen does not exist.
The 'screen' field is the bare id flow steps reference via step.screen — it MUST be resolvable by the product-truth validator for any approved flow that names it.
Populate the screen from the mock_data_ref records — never placeholder/lorem text (UXP-541).
Every entity MUST be a member of index.json entity_registry; set mock_data_ref to the dataset id whose records populate the screen.

Do NOT hand-edit the derived index maps or impl fields — after writing the mockup + HTML and registering the artifact in index.json artifacts[], run docs/product-truth/scripts/generate_product_truth.py, then validate_product_truth.py.
